name: PP-OCR Text Reader
description: On-device scene text reading with a fixed two-model PP-OCRv3 pipeline: DBNet text detection plus SVTR-LCNet recognition (6623 characters, Chinese + English). Publishes recognized texts over MQTT and streams H.264 via RTSP.
description_zh: 端侧场景文字识别，采用固定的两段式 PP-OCRv3 流水线：DBNet 文字检测 + SVTR-LCNet 识别（6623 字符，中英文）。通过 MQTT 发布识别文本，并以 RTSP 推送 H.264 视频。
author: Seeed Studio
